field.name: tracking_active
field.label: Enable WSC Tracking
field.description: Activate client-side tracker and edge AI crawler sensor

field.name: tracking_mode
field.label: Tracking Mode
field.description: Choose between cookieless privacy-first or consent-required mode
field.option: Cookieless Privacy-First (100% GDPR/ePrivacy compliant without cookie banner)
Consent-Required (Only tracks when visitor grants consent)

field.name: ip_handling
field.label: IP Address Privacy Mode (Zero-PII)
field.description: Raw client IP addresses are never stored. Choose rotating daily salted hash or full discard.
field.option: Rotating Salted Hash — SHA256(IP + UA + DailySalt)

field.name: exclude_admins
field.label: Exclude Administrators
field.description: Do not record visits from logged-in administrators

field.name: hybrid_enabled
field.label: Enable Hybrid Cloud Sync (Opt-In)
field.description: Opt-in to synchronize AES-256-CBC encrypted micro-batches with the WSC Gateway (api.worldsearchcouncil.org)

field.name: gateway_url
field.label: Gateway API URL
field.description: Base URL of WSC Gateway API

field.name: project_id
field.label: Project ID
field.description: Unique identifier assigned by the WSC Gateway upon opt-in registration

field.name: api_secret
field.label: Gateway HMAC Secret
field.description: HMAC-SHA256 signing secret issued by WSC Gateway (/v1/register)

field.name: local_key
field.label: Local 256-Bit AES Key
field.description: Local 64-char hex secret key used for AES-256-CBC micro-batch encryption

field.name: license_key
field.label: WSC Member / Agency License Key
field.description: Verify your live credential against www.worldsearchcouncil.org (or test with WSC-MEMBER-DEMO)

field.name: co_brand_name
field.label: Agency / Partner Display Name
field.description: Optional co-branding name synced with your WSC Agency profile

field.name: industry_vertical
field.label: Industry Benchmark Vertical
field.description: Taxonomy vertical used for WSC peer-group comparison

field.name: llms_txt_enabled
field.label: Enable Dynamic /llms.txt AI Manifest
field.description: Expose machine-readable Markdown overview of published Joomla content at /llms.txt

field.name: indexnow_enabled
field.label: Enable IndexNow Instant Push (Opt-In)
field.description: Automatically notify IndexNow search engines when published Joomla articles are saved

field.name: indexnow_key
field.label: IndexNow Verification Key
field.description: Automatically generated 32-character hexadecimal key served at /{key}.txt

field.name: bot_tracking_level
field.label: Bot Tracking Scope
field.description: Select which crawlers and bots to log at the edge layer
field.option: AI / LLM Bots only (GPTBot, Claude, Perplexity)

field.name: auto_media
field.label: Auto-track HTML5 video and audio playback

field.name: auto_time_on_page
field.label: Auto-track active engaged time on page

field.name: retention_days
field.label: Local Queue Retention (Days)
field.description: Number of days to keep synced records in local SQLite queue before pruning
